items.source: Return the WebSocket protocol extensions supported by the underlying WebSocket server.
items.translation: 返回底层 WebSocket 服务器支持的 WebSocket 协议扩展。

items.source: Return the supported WebSocket protocol versions.
items.translation: 返回支持的 WebSocket 协议版本。

items.source:
Perform runtime specific steps to complete the upgrade. Invoked after successful
negotiation of the handshake request.
items.translation: 执行运行时特定的步骤以完成升级。在成功协商握手请求后调用。

items.source: attributes - handshake request specific attributes to be set on the WebSocket session via HandshakeInterceptor and thus made available to the WebSocketHandler
items.translation: attributes - 通过HandshakeInterceptor设置在 WebSocket 会话上的握手请求特定属性，从而使其可供WebSocketHandler使用

items.source: HandshakeFailureException - thrown when handshake processing failed to complete due to an internal, unrecoverable error, i.e. a server error as opposed to a failure to successfully negotiate the requirements of the handshake request.
items.translation: HandshakeFailureException - 当握手处理因内部不可恢复的错误而未能完成时抛出，即服务器错误，而非握手请求要求协商失败。
selectedExtensions - 选定的 WebSocket 协议扩展

items.source: user - the user to associate with the WebSocket session
items.translation: user - 要与 WebSocket 会话关联的用户

items.source: A server-specific strategy for performing the actual upgrade to a WebSocket exchange.
items.translation: 用于执行到 WebSocket 交换机的实际升级的特定于服务器的策略。

items.source: Perform runtime specific steps to complete the upgrade.
items.translation: 执行运行时特定步骤以完成升级。
